help_desc: Blocks a user's main-chat or PM messages (or both), unblocks a user, or shows the blocked users and current settings.

msg_usage:
=== MESSAGE MANAGER ===========================================================

Usage:

    [+!#]msgmanager blockmain <NICK>  -- blocks a user's main messages
    [+!#]msgmanager blockpm <NICK>  -- blocks a user's pm messages
    [+!#]msgmanager blockboth <NICK>  -- blocks a user's main + pm messages
    [+!#]msgmanager unblock <NICK>  -- unblocks a user
    [+!#]msgmanager showusers  -- shows all blocked users
    [+!#]msgmanager showsettings  -- shows the settings from 'cfg.tbl'
   
=========================================================== MESSAGE MANAGER ===
